'''Itzeho''' was the fourth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Malola/Legends|Malola]] in the [[Mygeeto system/Legends|Mygeeto system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]]<ref name="Region" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Itzeho was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] ball without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Mygeeto system/Legends|Mygeeto system]], except [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />

The planet's name is almost identical to that of the real-world german city of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itzehoe Itzehoe].
